slides.headline: Binance hack hits {$6.3B}. Investigators point to North Korea

slides.title: 24 hours later

rows.sub: its own funds, to cover users

text: Binance is aiming to restart withdrawals on [Sunday].

slides.title: The Bybit hackers, again
text: The FBI tied Bybit to TraderTraitor. TRM and Chainalysis now link Binance to the [same group].

slides.title: "A complex attack"
text: Attackers abused an Ethereum feature ([EIP-7702]) to take over a hot wallet, then erased their tracks.
